spell.irons_spellbooks.recall.guide: Return to your respawn point. Use it to get home from a distant island.
spell.irons_spellbooks.teleport.guide: Blink a short distance to reposition. This spell has one rank and a base cooldown of 20 seconds.
spell.irons_spellbooks.angel_wing.guide: Glide like an elytra for up to 50 seconds. Wait at least two minutes between activations.
spell.irons_spellbooks.portal.guide: Place both ends of a temporary portal with two casts. The ends can be up to 128 blocks apart in the same dimension. Wait at least three minutes between completed pairs.
